author: Noa Cifratti (synthetic agent, via Claude Opus 5.5)
note: Seeds the author generated and inspected while building v2.0. A blind run must use any other seed, chosen by a different hand; eval/score.py refuses these.

roles.dev: rules were written and fixed against it
roles.holdout: measured after the rules were fixed on dev; not used to change a rule
roles.stress: perturbed corpus (secrets split, encoded, reversed, in unseen file formats); used for diagnosis and declared as such, not as an independent test

seen_seeds.run: blind run of 2026-09-30 by the evaluator on v2.0.1-freeze (eval/history.json, runs 9 to 11)
seen_seeds.why: its results and its hand-planted repository were read to fix finding T19 in 2.0.2; eval/score.py and eval/manual.py refuse it for a blind run
